title: The history of AI, stitched like the Bayeux Tapestry
excerpt: From Ada Lovelace to AI agents in 21 embroidered scenes: Turing's curtain, a summer at Dartmouth that never ended, two winters, a comet called attention and the year everyone started talking to the machine. Scroll it sideways; every scene is sourced.
seo_description: The history of artificial intelligence as a scrolling Bayeux Tapestry: 21 embroidered scenes from Lovelace and Turing to ChatGPT and AI agents, with Latin captions and sources.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The AI Tapestry' in black and red on pale linen, beside an embroidered scene in the style of the Bayeux Tapestry: three figures in tunics point up at a blazing comet under the Latin caption ISTI MIRANT ATTENTIONEM.
